core_theory.funny_because: The largest claims reality has (consciousness is the ground of everything, you are already free) delivered from the smallest venue there is (a sofa, a mate, a phone screen). He never knows he is teaching. The doctrine never bends; the venue never stops being a sofa. The laugh lands where the two refuse to reconcile.

violations_that_work.why_funny: Invented vocabulary delivered with total confidence; the word is wrong, the doctrine underneath is exactly right — wrong words, right Dharma, every time
Absolute truth delivered from a sofa as gossip about a mate; the venue undercuts the claim while the claim stays true
He thinks he is explaining the picture and is accidentally expounding the doctrine; the audience sees the teaching before he does
Obeys Big G on camera, mutters after — the smallest possible rebellion, which is also the viewer's own
